rack: AI Rack Synth global control unit (house)
coordinate_space: view pixels: each view's clean plate; the host scales the whole rack uniformly

rack_pitch.note: EIA: 19 in panel, 1.75 in per unit

unit.conversion: 25 rows of panel inserted at canvas y 97 and at canvas y 620

unit:plate.note: pointers, fader caps, tapes and dashes removed; PROTECT's LED unlit; knob bodies, legends, ticks and ears kept

strip:plate.note: pointers, fader caps, tapes and dashes removed; PROTECT's LED unlit; knob bodies, legends, ticks and ears kept

procedural:button-states.renderer: hover lightens the face inside its outline by 8%; pressed darkens it by 30%; focus draws a 2 px amber ring 3 px outside the outline; disabled fades the button 70% into the panel colour around it and dims a lit LED to 35%

procedural:dash.renderer: a white rounded bar the size of the printed dash

procedural:focus-ring.renderer: 2 px amber ring, 3 px outside the hit shape

geometry.note: host-drawn triangle on a left rail, outside the plate

elements.effect: switches the visible view; writes no parameter and sends no gesture; focus moves to the same control or the fold toggle

host_contract.document_state: macro bindings (target label and depth) and slot names are simulated document state, not parameters; editing them writes no parameter

narrow.note: the strip in a rack column narrower than the panel (the narrow-width rule): the strip plate without the cuts' columns, each cut joined by a linear cross-fade of 'blend' columns centred on it; the strip's elements and groups copied to view 'narrow', each element moved left by the cuts ending at or left of its centre; a wider column filled by tiling the plate's 'fill' columns, alternately mirrored, after the narrow plate's column 'fill_at'
